capabilities: Search a Zotero library from Obsidian and open or create literature notes
Insert citations and note links in [@citekey] format
Sync Zotero PDF highlights, annotations and child notes into a marked block in each paper's note
Link synced highlights back to the exact spot in the PDF via zotero:// links
Import Kindle My Clippings.txt highlights and match books to Zotero items
extras: Not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Sync is one-way (Zotero to Obsidian); Zotero must stay open for annotation sync; group libraries are not supported; no accounts, payments or network traffic beyond localhost.
intentEvidence: can replace the Citations plugin outright
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search a Zotero library, insert citations, or keep PDF annotations synchronized into notes.

relations.evidence: it connects only to the Zotero app on your own computer
Provides the citekeys that name your notes
can replace the Citations plugin outright
Those are powerful, template-driven importers that own the notes they create
If you came from Citations and want your highlights to show up, this is the lighter tool
the plugin reads the My Clippings.txt file every Kindle keeps on its own storage

requires.name: Zotero 7+ running on the same computer

summary: Zotero integration that searches your library, inserts citations, and syncs PDF highlights and Kindle clippings into literature notes.
